meta.project: BTBMS well-ordering from finite Mahlo reflection

phases.name: Review
phases.exit: Two blind reviews merged; every finding confirmed, disputed or refuted by the other reviewer.

phases.name: Repair & simplify
phases.exit: Every confirmed gap repaired and the repair checked by the other agent; simplified proof written. Gate G1: user signs off.

phases.name: Lean outline
phases.exit: Lean definitions and main statement written; claim graph mapped to Lean declarations. Gate G2: user signs off; statements locked.

phases.name: Formalize
phases.exit: Sorry count reaches zero; no new axioms; locked statements unchanged.

phases.name: Final verification
phases.exit: Cold recheck and axiom audit pass; statement-fidelity review written. Gate G3: user signs off.
